annotation_rules: Null means unknown, not atorigin and not airborne. Do not fit calibration through unknown/occluded feet.
Track same anatomical foot across a contact interval; label heel/toe roll when sole center changes within contact.
Root and commonreferenceHeight are clip-wide registration. Do not normalize each boundingbox independently.
Set accepted_unique_limb_art only after checking new joint/foot shape, registration, alpha, support and loop continuity.
artist_delivery_order: One coherent full walking cycle, specifically repairing3->4->5 support. Review at22logicalpx/s alongside original8.
Stop: final swing-foot recovery to stable side stand; support foot remains fixed. Multipleentryposes may be needed for different stopped phases.
Start: stable side stand->weightshift->first pawlift->initial stance, then distance-driven gait.
Turn: side stand->weightshift->threequarter/front->opposite side. Add appropriate coat/head registration for changing view.
Sit: side stand->hindlegflex->hip contact->forepaworder; reverse for rise. Preserve face/body size and floor.
